headline: Keurig Dr Pepper (KDP) Following Q2 Earnings Beat Is The Undervalued View Too Easy
summary: Why Keurig Dr Pepper Stock Is Back in Focus After Q2 Earnings Keurig Dr Pepper (KDP) is back on investor watchlists after second quarter 2026 results topped analyst expectations for adjusted earnings and net sales, and the company reaffirmed its full year outlook. The report highlighted growth in U.S. Refreshment Beverages and contributions from the JDE Peet's acquisition. U.S. Coffee trends were softer. This mix of segment outcomes is now central to how investors assess KDP. See our latest...
